question: Can ordinary mutation and paid inheritance produce independently arisen organisms whose own feedback improves useful actions, and whose blank-state descendants reacquire useful information under changed unseen assignments at a paid reproductive advantage?
novelty: A new Ora causal question about inherited reacquisition, not a global novelty claim or repeat of closed Pressure71 mutation/selection comparisons. No standalone repeat of those discovery arms is authorized.

discovery.faithful_control_reuse: One common faithful control per reserved source condition can serve both predeclared mutation-dose blocks; do not launch biologically duplicate faithful controls or count reuse as extra independence. No arm has execution authority yet.
discovery.sampling_definition: Chronologically first paid birth with at least one ordinary COPY mutation relative to its recorded effective source; no genotype/fitness/opcode/learning screen. Preserve that actual origin even if it dies before exposure or reproduction. No such birth gives a zero discovery outcome. Every other birth remains in the ledger but is not substituted as a better origin.
discovery.offspring_definition: Actual paid descendant with the selected origin's unchanged inherited genome and blank private state. Absence, death, or insufficient followup stays in the whole-world denominator; no fabricated genotype or transplanted acquired answer.
discovery.faithful_child_limit: A prospective same-genotype diagnostic restriction, not a phenotype winner screen. It can miss functional inheritance with additional mutations. Transmission opportunity differs by dose; under a uniform-independent-draw assumption a complete27word copy is unchanged with probability (1-p)^27, not a viability or useful-origin probability. Report missing-child and fidelity outcomes separately and retain failures.
discovery.independence: Independent discovery Worlds/origins, not forages, births, within-World branches or diagnostic clones. Multiple origins in one World cannot be counted as independent replications. Faithful/ancestor-copy blocks are controls, not new scientific discoveries by themselves.

resource_matching.matching_limit: Same reserved source rules/schedules/start state and paid budgets; admission, captures, competition, censoring and death are outcomes. Global time is not personal time. Diagnostic formation, fork and opportunity costs are separately priced, never free ecological resources.

functional_claim.fixed_port_rule: Disclose fixed0 and fixed1 separately but compare the predeclared balanced allocation, never a post-target matching oracle. Pay all assigned reference Worlds; no two free founders.
functional_claim.supplied_learning_benchmark: The paid feedback-reactive reference is a disclosed positive/efficiency benchmark, not mandatory superiority for the narrow mutation-origin useful-learning claim. Beating it would support a separate stronger efficiency claim; no prior closed criteria are changed.
functional_claim.primary_proposed_outcome: Per assigned discovery World, count a causal inherited-reacquisition success only when the complete registered conjunction is supported. Every failed/unexposed/dead/no-origin/no-faithful-child World remains; no diagnostic-clone denominator. This is not an accepted result or a frozen statistical test yet.
outcome_vector: paid births and offspring with their own paid child by horizon

diagnostics.role_count: 3 panels times3 causal states plus5 reference roles =14 reserved fork roles. This is only a schematic ceiling, not an executable protocol or qualified budget.
diagnostics.no_origin_or_child: Keep failure/absence. Unused reserved roles are not reassigned to a more promising organism.
diagnostics.authority: Each clone/restored counterfactual is a separately counted scientific World with explicit source, custody and resource admission. No authored diagnostic/reference genotype may be inserted into discovery. Ancestor reversion/reference formation and changed-assignment interventions need separate paid source qualification and any required operator approval.
diagnostics.causal_limit: Blind-code comparison alone cannot attribute an effect to acquired information. Erasing all private state can destroy motor phase or reproduction; feedback corruption can alter reflexes. Lesion/sham must be exact, nonlethal, phase/resource matched where possible and independently reviewed, never free analyst target/presence labels. All induced costs remain outcomes.
diagnostics.checkpoint_rule: Match intact/sham/lesion arms within each actual source checkpoint, including genotype, age, PC, food, neighbours, global time and paid resources before intervention. Parent and newborn checkpoints naturally differ; never posthoc-match across panels or pretend their age/ecology is identical.
diagnostics.replication_rule: One deterministic fork per causal state is not independent replication or a per-World significance test. Component thresholds and paired-effect inference must be frozen across independent discovery Worlds; common-faithful reuse is correlated. Any extra reserved contexts/replications multiply scientific Worlds and costs and require prospective budget revision, never an in-run extension.
diagnostics.reserved_change: Descendant earns new information itself after a precommitted changed hidden assignment; no trained-state transplant. Assignment generation and information lifetime contrast are NOT YET source-qualified. No reserved seed has been assigned or queried.

registration.reason: Bounds below are ceilings, not useful-origin lower bounds or power. Do not manufacture a sample size, effect margin or CPU budget from opcode counts or closed outcomes.

prohibited: new World or VM execution by this preparation
preparation_scope: Static source/metadata/finite integer bounds and synthetic receipt-shape fixtures only. No real causal panel or functional success is available or certified.
